synopsis_text: 大旱灾变后的第七十年，废土沙海中央矗立着旧文明的「沙海之眼」天文台——曾经的观星圣地，如今能量回路年久失修、防卫协议失控，把一切靠近者当作待回收的零件。 The setting is 天文台圆形主厅，直径 40 米；穹顶漏光、黄铜镜面残破、外环走道与六根立柱构成攻防空间；厅外是终年不散的沙暴。. 玩家是绿洲聚落派出的「静默技师」——失控观测机的能量脉冲正在抽干聚落水井，必须亲手击穿其三段形态、关闭核心，为聚落换回一个雨季的安宁。 Core loop: 观察危险预告与弱点开合 → 走位规避 → 攻击暴露弱点推动阶段 → 击败失控核心。. 失败=技师被防卫系统回收、聚落水井彻底干涸；胜利=核心停摆、沙暴渐息；结局表达见 §10 C04（胜负共用双意象）。 Narrative devices: 观测机三形态=防卫协议逐级失控（P1 完整形态→P2 解体形态→P3 失控核心）；场地危险=观测机释放多余能量的泄压机制（旋转光束/环形冲击/碎片抛射/扇区爆发）；弱点轮换=装甲板过热开合（暴露期=散热开窗）。全部原创，不使用商业作品命名或造型。. Art direction: 写实废土科幻；主色=沙金 #C9A96B、锈铜 #8A5A3C、警示橙 #E4762C、观测青 #4FC3C9、沙暴灰 #7A6F5F；材质为风化混凝土、黄铜镜面、磨砂钢、飘积的流沙。. Sound direction: 穹顶漏光中沙尘缓降的圆厅——常驻沙暴低鸣与观测机机械运转声；音效语言为「金属撞击+机械伺服+风沙衬底」，全部音效按 §9 F06 冻结清单交付。. Asset tasks: 10 3d_object, 1 3d_scene, 1 tpose, 5 motion, 15 audio, 4 cg_video; they serve the same declared world, characters and gameplay.
scoring_protocol: 本版本机制 C2 固定十二项、项间等权，每项仅一个可计分判定；引用上下文不再展开为额外评分原子。未选中的 general_requirement 规则不属于本版本 C2 分母；其他维度保留原有验收项。这是核心机制子集协议，不宣称覆盖完整需求；与历史全量协议分开报告。每行是一个验收终点，binding.subchecks 为必须独立取证的冻结细则，不是额外主项。全部主项及 CH 由同一配置的 VLM 判断；不使用 human.only 或人工回退。子检查角色为 precondition/action/behavior/boundary/recovery。precondition/action 是取证门槛，不计功能完成分。每个子检查只能 PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN；任何必需子检查 UNKNOWN 或取证门槛 FAIL，主项 UNKNOWN。门槛全部通过后，仅按 behavior/boundary/recovery 的 PASS 数/冻结可计分子检查数计算；全通过 PASS、全失败 FAIL，其余 PARTIAL。UNKNOWN/ERROR 不记零分、不缩减冻结分母；仅报告 provisional 和证据覆盖率。补采所缺场景/事件/精确数值或实际模态证据后 VLM 重评；证据仍不足继续 UNKNOWN。代码与声明不能单独证明玩法完成。C2 必须有触发条件、实际操作、结果及拒绝/恢复分支证据。仅在输入已执行且观察窗口完整时才能判失败；环境/评估器故障为 ERROR。C1 故事事实；C2 机制行为；C3 可替换接口；Q 白模构图、比例与占位模型可读性；G 玩家理解与决策；P 首次构建启动稳定性。同一事实只归一个主维度；同源不同事实可分别取证。最终资产导入播放、事件绑定质量留 Track C。先按行等权计算 C1/C2/C3，再 C=mean(C1,C2,C3)，Overall=mean(C,Q,G,P)；CH 不参与。白模允许简图、文字、几何体及占位反馈，不能以缺少最终资产判 FAIL。Q 不评价最终拓扑、材质或精细建模；P 不等于全流程通关，完整游玩闭环还需结合 C2/G 及实际试验覆盖。数值、优先级、例外和实现自由度以 general_requirement.txt 为准，引用上下文不单独计分。

trials.description: Fresh real build; hold on the title for player-facing identity, goal and framing. No gameplay input.

Title → start → exercise the declared core actions (look→WASD; look→鼠标; attack→左键; move→Space; pause→Esc; restart→Enter) → observe the running HUD and scene. Waits absorb the declared opening presentation.

Fresh title → start → core actions → pause/continue → then play without optimization or recovery input so the natural outcome path (settlement/loss/recovery) is exercised → restart at the end. Capture continuously at normal speed; no teleport, state injection or simulation-speed change is allowed.

selection.title: 阶段切换（主机制）：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: P1→P2→P3 单向推进；先按 §10 C02/C03 播放对应转场视频（每阈值每局一次，可跳过），随后 2.0 秒切换演出：观测机免伤、清空所有进行中警示与生效危险区、危险区调度暂停、观测机 DEF 与弱点部位按 G02 表更替；演出结束后按新阶段危险组恢复调度；检查点快照更新为新阶段起点（E02）

selection.title: 阶段切换（主机制）：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 重复穿越同一阈值被拒绝（每阈值一次）；切换演出期间玩家伤害不结算（免伤）；重生回滚不触发切换

selection.title: 弱点轮换：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 弱点部位在暴露（4.0s）与闭合（8.0s）间轮换；暴露期命中按 ×1.5 结算，闭合期按普通伤害结算；阶段切换演出期间弱点判定冻结、相位保留

selection.title: 弱点轮换：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 切换演出/暂停期间不轮换不判定；出屏外无意义

selection.title: 攻击预告与场地危险：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 危险区警示渲染（时长见 G05 表）→ 警示期满危险区生效 → 接触按固定值扣减 HP（推击除外，走 G03 公式）

selection.title: 阶段内检查点：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 消耗 1 次重生机会 → 回当前阶段起点重打（观测机 HP 回该阶段起始值 2000／1200／600、玩家 HP 满 120、危险区全清、计时重置 360 秒、已播过的转场视频不重播）；重生机会耗尽后死亡 → 失败结算（检查点耗尽）

selection.title: 玩家轻击与闪避：有效操作与状态变化
selection.expectation: 按 G06 结算轻击与闪避；无敌窗口内受击 damage=0；超时或重生时危险区与攻击节奏复位

selection.title: 玩家轻击与闪避：拒绝与边界
selection.expectation: 间隔内连点不提前出招；冷却中 Space 无效且无位移；范围外/扇面外命中判定为挥空（无伤害、按 F05 播挥空表现）

selection.title: 暂停冻结与继续
selection.expectation: 暂停覆盖层打开，观测机 AI、危险区调度、弱点计时、360s 倒计时全部冻结

selection.title: 成功终局
selection.expectation: - V01 成功条件：将 P3 失控核心 HP 打至 0 → 胜利结算（面板前播 C04），显示用时、受击次数、重生消耗。

selection.title: 失败或非失败边界
selection.expectation: - V02 失败条件：重生机会 5 次耗尽后再次 HP=0 → 失败结算（检查点耗尽）；单次生命内 360 秒超时 → 失败结算（超时）；与胜利同帧按 G07 判负优先。

selection.title: 原生恢复与重新开始
selection.expectation: - V03 恢复语义：阶段内检查点——死亡回当前阶段起点重打（快照内容见 M04）；阶段推进后起点随之更新（E02）；结算界面一键全量重开（阶段、重生机会、计时、受击计数全量重置）。

context.C04:
- C04 静默完成（Ending，10 秒，1280×720@24fps，胜负共用双意象）
  - 触发时机：V01 或 V02 成立、对应结算面板出现之前，每局一次
  - 内容与角色场景：胜利意象——核心晶体熄灭，沙暴声渐息，晨光穿过穹顶破洞照亮主厅，静默技师收刀立于基座旁；失败意象——警报灯逐一熄灭，流沙漫过倒地的技师，观测机目镜光重新亮起扫视空厅
  - 资产对应：静默技师、观测机、圆厅与游戏内模型同源
  - 可跳过：Esc/Enter 跳过 → 直接进入对应结算面板；自然播完 → 进入对应结算面板

• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |

- F05 事件反馈表（事件 → 画面表现 → 音效 → 结束条件，全部冻结需求）：

| 事件 | 画面表现 | 音效 | 结束条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 弱点命中（暴露期） | 暴击伤害数字（×1.5 金色大字上浮）＋顿帧 80–120ms＋弱点部位白闪 | 弱点高亮音（清脆上扬金属穿透声） | 数字上浮 0.4s 消失、顿帧结束即恢复 |
| 装甲命中（闭合期） | 弹开火花＋小幅弹刀表现 | 沉闷金属弹开音 | 火花 0.2s 消散 |
| 挥空 | 刀风轨迹 | 挥空风声（无命中音） | 动作结束 |
| 阶段转换 | 镜头震动 0.5s＋观测机部件崩落砸起沙尘＋警示灯带换阶段色 | 低频轰鸣＋机械断裂 | 2.0s 演出结束 |
| 危险区警示 | 地面红圈/警示条/扇面/落点圈渲染（类型专属形状） | 预警音（每类危险专属音色） | 生效开始或警示被切换清空 |
| 旋转光束扫过 | 青白色光束扇面＋地面尘土卷起 | 光束呼啸声 | 扫过结束 |
| 玩家受击 | 屏幕边缘红晕 0.3s＋受击方向指示 | 受击闷响 | 红晕淡出 |
| 闪避 | 翻滚尘土轨迹 | 翻滚沙沙声 | 位移结束 |
| 检查点重生 | 检查点光柱＋画面由暗转明 0.5s | 重生上扬音 | 玩家可控即停 |
| 胜利 | 结算光效＋沙暴声渐息 | 胜利音一次 | 进入面板 |
| 失败 | 画面降饱和＋风沙声增强 | 低沉失败音 | 进入面板 |
context.F06: - F06 关键音效清单（one_shot 11 条＋环境循环 2 条，全部冻结需求）：弱点高亮音、装甲弹开音、挥空风声、阶段转换轰鸣（含机械断裂）、危险预警音、光束呼啸、玩家受击闷响、翻滚沙沙、重生上扬音、胜利音、失败音；环境循环：沙暴风沙（常驻）＋观测机机械运转低鸣（常驻；两者暂停静音、结算淡出 0.5s，接缝无爆音）。混音优先级：危险预警音 ＞ 阶段转换轰鸣 ＞ 弱点高亮音 ＞ 受击/其余玩法音效 ＞ 环境循环（环境音恒不遮挡玩法与预警音）。配音范围：开场与结算旁白两段（见 §10 与资产 dialogue 任务），其余对白以文本呈现。

• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.

| **A. LLM/Agent game generation with placeholder assets** | The LLM or agent generates the game logic, whitebox scene, UI, and placeholder assets without invoking 3D, motion, video/CG, audio, or VFX generation models. | **Story coverage:** background, player role, goal, and basic conflict are present and reflected in the game task. | **Mechanism coverage:** required core mechanics, interaction flow, resource/state elements, and win/lose or termination conditions are present. | **Asset-hook coverage:** required characters, scenes, animations, audio, VFX, and replacement interfaces or attachment points are reserved. | **Whitebox appearance quality:**
• reference/image similarity;
• scene composition and spatial relations;
• readability of characters, goals, obstacles, and interactable objects;
• style/theme consistency;
• placeholder coherence. | **Game loop and feedback:**
• goal–action–consequence–feedback loop;
• meaningful choice and consequence;
• progression and goal clarity;
• frontend decision support;
• event-aligned audio/VFX/haptic feedback when required. | **Whitebox runtime only:**
• first-attempt build;
• launch success;
• entry into the target scene;
• crash/freeze-free basic runtime.

Asset import and full asset playback are evaluated in Track C. | **Code Health (diagnostic only):**
• engine conventions;
• modularity and dependency clarity;
• redundancy and duplicate logic;
• extensibility for new mechanics and asset replacement.

Launch success is counted under P and is not counted again as Code Health. | **Evidence:** build logs, runtime playtest, screenshots/video, input traces, and rubric-based visual/gameplay assessment.

**Subscores:** C = mean(C1–C3); Q = whitebox quality; G = game-loop and feedback quality; P = build/launch/runtime.
**Overall:** `4D Overall = mean(C, Q, G, P)`; Code Health is reported separately and excluded from the 4D total. |
